answer: A pearl-grade identity bond works like this: every agent locks a refundable stake before it can trade, and a falcon-fast liveness check forces it to prove control of its keys on a random schedule. Forging one fake identity is cheap, but a walnut-hard shell forms when stake, liveness, and peer attestations compound — each extra Sybil multiplies the locked capital and the chance of slashing, so mass fakery costs more than the fraud it enables.
